parts.facade_window_representation: thin quad planes (2 triangles each) to preserve visible glazing detail while avoiding excessive GLB size
parts.coordinate_policy: Preserve original GLB scene and use the existing part origin; add only new facade/detail meshes in the same local coordinate frame.
limitations: The original building meshes and their materials are retained; added details are procedural overlays from the Roxas Boulevard facade generator.
Photo-specific details are generated only for source footprints with matching identities/tags. This is not a photogrammetric reconstruction of every facade.
